messages.subject: RE: Project Ironhold - A&R Agreement v3 (company turn)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Our turn attached. We accept the 4.50% margin, the 2.00% commitment fee and the 0.60x super-senior cap. On the amendment fee we've come to 690,000 - please confirm the Bank can agree there. We've also widened the equity cure to three cures over the life of the facilities (max two in any 24 months), which the IBR low case supports. Subject to those two, we're essentially at agreed form.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
